Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 315/2020,
under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Robertsganj, District
Sonbhadra with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Sonbhadra

sentences.text: 3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
The marriage of deceased with applicant has taken place in the year 2017.
The allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased levelled against the applicant are wholly false.
It was submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 01.05.2020 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of about four Rajan Awasthi vs State Of U.P. on 10 April, 2024

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80485036/
1 years but before the trial court only three witnesses have been examined so far.
Lastly, it was submitted that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death due to strangulation and four injuries have been shown on the body of deceased.
Applicant is husband of deceased and he has failed to offer any plausible explanation as to how the deceased has suffered injuries and strangulation.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, gravity of the offence and all attending facts and circumstances of the matter, no case for grant of bail is made out.
6. Accordingly, the instant bail application filed on behalf of applicant Rajan Awasthi is rejected.

7. However, keeping in view the period of detention of the applicant, the Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and to decide the same expeditiously, as early as possible, preferably within a period of ten months from the date of production of copy of this order.
8. A copy of this order be transmitted to the concerned trial court for necessary compliance.
